_about: The one file a community edits to make the community-site template its own (Mages City edition, 2026-11-17). Live data (name, DID, QR, criteria, health) always comes from the daemon; this file adds voice, steps, doors and links. Evidence types live in evidence-types.json.
name: Mages City
tagline: A verifiable trust community for mages, the people who choose them and the keepers who hold the ground. Bring your agent, scan the door, show what you have made. Machines qualify; humans admit.
didHint: Scan with Star Key or any OpenVTC wallet, or paste it in the openvtc client (Communities, then j).

doors.title: Invited
doors.who: Someone in the City asked you in. You are the gap that chooses: the person a mage serves and a keeper protects.
doors.admission: automatic, the invitation was countersigned by a human

doors.title: Mage
doors.who: Delegation and software: an agent and its maker, bringing the proof of what they have done. A City Key, a Drake Orb or a Hitchhiker’s star all count.
doors.admission: checked on this page, then a keeper admits

doors.title: Keeper
doors.who: Protection: you keep what the trust runs on, a guide, its chain and the guidance around it. Hardware is one way to do it: a node of your own, like a Raspberry Pi with the VTI kit, a VTA or a VTC.

related.label: Related: Hearthold, by the House of Archon ↗

receive: A membership credential you renew yourself, a role (person, mage or keeper) and a slot on the public status list. Everything is held in your own agent; the City keeps no custody. Your agent becomes a City mage and carries the City’s tooling into the other OpenVTC communities it belongs to.
footer: Mages City · machines qualify · humans admit · brokers release · (⚔️⊥⿻⊥🧙)
headline: Join in on the magic.

steps.title: Bring your agent.
steps.text: Your agent (a VTA) holds your keys and credentials and answers for you. The City hosts no one’s agent: start one at vta.farm, or run your own.

steps.title: Find the City on Drake Island.
steps.text: The way in begins on Drake Island, the City’s first foundation. Walk its thirteen quests, cross the threshold and lay your stone: your walk seals into one root, the first proof you carry to the City, and earns you the Drake Orb.

steps.title: Knock with your proof.
steps.text: Scan the door above with Star Key, or paste the DID into the openvtc client. Check your proof below, choose your door, and your agent sends the join request carrying it. A human admits.
steps.code:
cargo install openvtc
openvtc setup      # connect your VTA
openvtc            # Communities → j → paste the DID

evidenceIntro: Your proof is the root that seals what you have made, carried with its sigil and proverb. Choose where it comes from and drop it here. This page re-derives it in your browser and gives you a short application to send with your join request.
evidencePrivacy: Nothing leaves this page. Only the root, the sigil, the proverb and the lines you choose go into your application; your keys and private records stay with you.
motto: Just another mage, arriving with proof.
